item.description:
New in 0.1.5

  • Event icons. Events with a video call show a camera, events that mention a meeting show people, and events with a link show a link mark, right beside the title, inside blocks and out. All detected from the event itself, nothing leaves your Mac. Toggle in Settings.
  • Collapsed groups show their contents. A thin colored strip on a collapsed group traces every hidden event, so a folded group can never hide a busy afternoon.
  • Reorder anything. Groups drag into a new order just like calendars, and every drag now shows a live insertion line, the drop lands exactly where the line shows.
  • One-line titles. A new setting tightens every event label to a single line for denser timelines.
  • Crisper structure. Group rows carry a hairline boundary across the sidebar and canvas, and the timeline background is now identical on every version of macOS. Sequoia users, no more gray canvas.

Feedback

Send anything, bugs, ideas, confusion, to evan@sandpipermediagroup.com.
